hindi: इससे सब ओर अनर्थ और अर्थ के संशय की व्याख्या हो गई।
english: By this, [the adversity of] doubt of loss and gain on all sides is explained.
notes: The feminine nom. sg. saṃśayā/vyākhyātā agrees with an understood āpad (adversity), as in unit 44; the supplied noun is bracketed in English only.

words.gloss: adversity of doubt of gain and loss

hindi: इधर अर्थ, उधर अनर्थ का संशय — इस प्रकार दोनों ओर अर्थ और अनर्थ के संशय की आपत्ति।
english: Gain on this side, doubt of loss on the other — thus the adversity of doubt of gain and loss on both sides.

hindi: इससे सब ओर अर्थ और अनर्थ के संशय की व्याख्या हो गई।
english: By this, [the adversity of] doubt of gain and loss on all sides is explained.
notes: Same construction as unit 43; the feminine agreement points to an understood āpad.

hindi: उसमें प्रकृतियों में से हर पहली को अनर्थ के संशयों से छुड़ाने का प्रयत्न करे।
english: In that, one should strive to free each earlier one of the constituent elements from doubts of loss.
notes: The grammar is loose: pūrvāṃ pūrvām (f. acc. sg.) with anartha-saṃśayān (m. acc. pl.) both as accusatives. Alternative: pūrvān pūrvān (m. acc. pl.) agreeing with saṃśayān, i.e. "the earlier and earlier doubts of loss of the constituent elements". Draft keeps the printed reading.

hindi: क्योंकि अनर्थ के संशय में खड़ा मित्र अधिक अच्छा है, दण्ड नहीं; अथवा दण्ड, कोश नहीं।
english: For better the ally standing in doubt of loss, not the army; or the army, not the treasury.
notes: tiṣṭhan is masculine while mitram is neuter; the agreement is loose (an understood person or the king standing in doubt is possible). Closing iti not rendered. Order of exposure: ally, then army, then treasury.

words.gloss: in the absence of complete freeing

hindi: सम्पूर्ण छुड़ाने के अभाव में प्रकृतियों के अंशों को छुड़ाने का प्रयत्न करे।
english: In the absence of complete freeing, one should strive to free parts of the constituent elements.

words.gloss: excluding the fierce and the greedy

hindi: वहाँ मनुष्य-प्रकृतियों में बहुत या अनुरक्त को, तीक्ष्ण और लोभी को छोड़कर; द्रव्य-प्रकृतियों में बहुमूल्य या बड़े उपकार वाले को।
english: There, of the human constituent elements, [one should free] the large or the devoted [part], excluding the fierce and the greedy; of the material constituent elements, the valuable [part] or that of great usefulness.
notes: Verb and noun "part" supplied from unit 48 (bracketed in English). tīkṣṇa rendered literally as "fierce"; the glossary sense "assassin" belongs to the agent contexts and is only an alternative here. bahulam could be "numerous" or "large"; the word supplied after anuraktam is uncertain.

hindi: हल्के सन्धि, आसन अथवा द्वैधीभाव से, भारी विपरीतों से।
english: The light ones: by peace, staying quiet (āsana) or the dual policy; the heavy ones: by the opposites.
notes: No verb in the Sanskrit; the neuter plurals laghūni/gurūṇi have no stated noun (the adversities or doubts of the preceding passage are probable). āsana literally "sitting". viparyayaiḥ: by the contrary [means].

hindi: और क्षय, स्थान और वृद्धि में से उत्तरोत्तर को प्राप्त करना चाहे।
english: And of decline, stagnation and growth, one should seek to obtain the later and later one.

hindi: अथवा उलटे क्रम से क्षय आदि के भविष्य में विशेष को देखे।
english: Or, by the reverse order, one should see the difference of decline and the rest in the future.
notes: viśeṣa is "difference" or "distinction"; "advantage" is a possible alternative sense. prātilomya = reversal of the order of unit 51.

hindi: इस प्रकार देश का निर्धारण।
english: Thus, the determination of place.

words.gloss: at the beginning, middle and end of the march

hindi: इससे यात्रा के आदि, मध्य और अन्त में अर्थ, अनर्थ और संशयों की प्राप्ति की व्याख्या हो गई।
english: By this, the encountering of gain, loss and doubt at the beginning, middle and end of the march is explained.
notes: Compound artha-anartha-saṃśayānām read as three items (gain, loss, doubt) because of the plural saṃśayānām; "doubt of gain and loss" is the alternative. upasamprāpti rendered "encountering"; "attainment" is possible.

words.gloss: at the start of the march
in the warding off of the heel-seizer and the reinforcer
in decline, expenditure, absence abroad and recovery
in the protections of the root

hindi: निरन्तर सम्बन्ध होने से अर्थ, अनर्थ और संशयों में, यात्रा के आरम्भ में अर्थ प्राप्त करना अधिक अच्छा है, और पार्ष्णिग्राह तथा आसार के निवारण में, क्षय, व्यय, प्रवास और पुनः ग्रहण में तथा मूल की रक्षाओं में होता है।
english: And because of the continuous connection of gain, loss and doubt, gain is better to encounter at the start of the march, and it is [so] in warding off the heel-seizer and the reinforcer, in decline, expenditure, absence abroad and recovery, and in the protections of the root.
notes: The syntax of the closing series is loose: "bhavati" is taken as "is [so]" for the series pārṣṇi-grāha-āsāra-pratighāte ... mūla-rakṣaṇeṣu. pratyādeya = "to be taken back / recovery" is uncertain (alternative: restoration of what was taken). pravāsa = living away from home. mūla = root or base (the home territory). The Hindi attaches "ca ... bhavati" at the end.

words.gloss: of one standing on his own ground

hindi: वैसे ही अपनी भूमि पर खड़े रहने वाले के लिए अनर्थ या संशय सहने योग्य होता है।
english: Likewise, loss or doubt is bearable for one standing on his own ground.

words.gloss: in the middle of the march

hindi: इससे यात्रा के मध्य में अर्थ, अनर्थ और संशयों की प्राप्ति की व्याख्या हो गई।
english: By this, the encountering of gain, loss and doubt in the middle of the march is explained.

words.gloss: at the end of the march
from fear of harassment by the enemy

hindi: किन्तु यात्रा के अन्त में, क्षीण करने योग्य अथवा उच्छेद करने योग्य को क्षीण करके या उखाड़कर, अर्थ प्राप्त करना अधिक अच्छा है, अनर्थ या संशय नहीं, शत्रु की बाधा के भय से।
english: But at the end of the march, gain is better to encounter, after weakening or uprooting [the one] to be weakened or to be uprooted, not loss or doubt, from fear of harassment by the enemy.
notes: The objects of karśayitvā/ucchidya are taken to be the two gerundives (an understood enemy). para = "the other", rendered "the enemy"; ābādha = harassment or trouble.

words.gloss: of one who is not the leader
reaching the middle or end of the march

hindi: किन्तु सामवायिकों में जो अग्रणी नहीं है, उसके लिए यात्रा के मध्य या अन्त तक पहुँचने वाला अनर्थ या संशय प्राप्त करना अधिक अच्छा है, बिना आग्रह के चलने के कारण।
english: But for one who is not the leader of the associates, loss or doubt reaching the middle or end of the march is better to encounter, because of going without insistence.
notes: Obscure: sāmavāyika (associates, members of a joint undertaking), apuroga (not going in front), -ga ("going to" or "occurring in") and anirbandha-gāmitva (going without insistence or stubbornness) are rendered literally. Who goes without insistence (the associates or the follower) is not stated. Alternative: "occurring in the middle or at the end of the march".

hindi: “अर्थ, धर्म, काम” — अर्थ का त्रिवर्ग है।
english: “Gain, dharma, desire” — the triad of gain.
notes: artha-tri-varga: the triad headed by artha (the group of three whose first member is gain); iti shown by the quotation marks.

hindi: उसमें पहले-पहले को प्राप्त करना अधिक अच्छा है।
english: Of that, each earlier one is better to encounter.

hindi: “अनर्थ, अधर्म, शोक” — अनर्थ का त्रिवर्ग है।
english: “Loss, unrighteousness, grief” — the triad of loss.

hindi: उसमें पहले-पहले का प्रतिकार करना अधिक अच्छा है।
english: Of that, each earlier one is better to remedy.

hindi: “अर्थ-अनर्थ”, “धर्म-अधर्म”, “काम-शोक” — संशय का त्रिवर्ग है।
english: “Gain [or] loss,” “dharma [or] unrighteousness,” “desire [or] grief” — the triad of doubt.
notes: The pairs are read as the doubts "is it gain or loss?" etc.; "or" is bracketed in English and shown by hyphens in Hindi. Alternative: "gain as loss" (the one taken for the other).

words.gloss: in the success of the latter side

hindi: उसमें उत्तर पक्ष की सिद्धि होने पर पूर्व पक्ष प्राप्त करना अधिक अच्छा है।
english: Of that, in the success of the latter side, the former side is better to encounter.
notes: Obscure. tasya-uttara-pakṣa-siddhau: "of that, in the success of the latter side". Sides read as the two halves of each doubt pair of unit 64 (gain/loss etc.). siddhi could be "accomplishment, coming about"; alternative: "if the latter side is established (as certain)".

hindi: इस प्रकार काल का निर्धारण।
english: Thus, the determination of time.

hindi: इस प्रकार आपत्तियाँ। उनकी सिद्धि।
english: Thus the adversities. Their success.
notes: GROUPING: "ity āpadaḥ" closes the preceding section on adversities, while "tāsāṃ siddhiḥ" is the heading of the next section (success against the adversities, units 68 onwards). The dash joins two separate items.

words.gloss: among townsmen, country people and chiefs of the army
among neighbouring chiefs and forest chiefs

hindi: पुत्रों, भाइयों और बन्धुओं में साम और दान से सिद्धि उचित है; नगरवासियों, जनपदवासियों और सेना के मुखियों में दान और भेद से; सामन्तों और आटविकों में भेद और दण्ड से।
english: Among sons, brothers and kinsmen, success by conciliation and gifts is suitable; among townsmen, country people and chiefs of the army, by gifts and dissension; among neighbouring chiefs and forest chiefs, by dissension and force.
notes: daṇḍa-mukhya read as "chiefs of the army" (alternative: paura-jānapada-daṇḍa-mukhya as "chiefs of the townsmen, country people and army"). sāmanta: neighbouring ruler or chief. In bheda-daṇḍābhyām daṇḍa is the upāya "force".

hindi: यह अनुलोम है; विपर्यय में प्रतिलोम।
english: This is in direct order; in the opposite [case], in inverse order.

hindi: मित्रों और अमित्रों में सिद्धि मिश्रित है।
english: Among allies and enemies, success is mixed.

hindi: क्योंकि उपाय परस्पर साधक हैं।
english: For the means are mutually accomplishing.

hindi: शत्रु के शंकित अमात्यों में प्रयुक्त साम शेष के प्रयोग को रोक देता है; दूष्य अमात्यों में दान, संघातों में भेद, शक्तिमानों में दण्ड।
english: Among the enemy’s suspected ministers, conciliation, when applied, turns back the use of the rest; among the treasonable ministers, gifts; among united groups, dissension; among the powerful, force.
notes: śaṅkita may mean "suspected" or "suspicious (of their own king)". sāntva = sāma, conciliation. saṅghāta: banded or united groups. Closing iti not rendered (unquoted).

words.gloss: from connection with heaviness and lightness

hindi: और आपत्तियों के गुरुत्व और लघुत्व के योग से नियोग, विकल्प और समुच्चय होते हैं।
english: And from the connection of the adversities with heaviness and lightness, there are niyoga (restriction), vikalpa (option) and samuccaya (combination).
notes: The three terms are defined in units 74 to 76. yoga here = connection.

hindi: “इसी उपाय से, दूसरे से नहीं” — नियोग है।
english: “By this very means, not by another” — niyoga (restriction).

hindi: “इससे या दूसरे से” — विकल्प है।
english: “By this or by another” — vikalpa (option).

hindi: “इससे और दूसरे से” — समुच्चय है।
english: “By this and by another” — samuccaya (combination).

hindi: उनमें एक योग वाले चार और तीन योग वाले, दो योग वाले छह, चार योग वाला एक।
english: Of these, four are of one combination and [four] of three combinations, six of two combinations, one of four combinations.
notes: The number of the three-combination kind is not stated; catvāraḥ is taken to govern both (four plus four plus six plus one gives the fifteen of unit 78). The count is bracketed in English.

hindi: इस प्रकार पन्द्रह उपाय।
english: Thus, fifteen means.

hindi: उतने प्रतिलोम हैं।
english: That many [are] the inverse ones.

hindi: उनमें एक उपाय से सिद्धि एक-सिद्धि है, दो से द्वि-सिद्धि, तीन से त्रि-सिद्धि, चार से चतुः-सिद्धि।
english: Of these, success by one means is single success; by two, double success; by three, triple success; by four, fourfold success.

words.gloss: from having dharma as its root
from having desire as its fruit
linked with dharma, gain and desire

hindi: अर्थ धर्म के मूल वाला और काम के फल वाला है, इसलिए अर्थ की जो सिद्धि धर्म, अर्थ और काम से जुड़ी है, वह सब अर्थों की सिद्धि है। इस प्रकार सिद्धियाँ।
english: Because gain has dharma as its root and desire as its fruit, that success of gain which is linked with dharma, gain and desire is the success of all aims. Thus, the successes.

text_flags.why: visarga lost (plain h in the e-text); the word is the nominative plural siddhayaḥ

notes: The printed line contains the danda marks and the verse number 81 inside the line; they are kept as tokens. sarva-artha: "all aims" (artha as aim); "all gains" is the alternative. anubandha: attached, connected, or consequent.

hindi: दैव से अग्नि, जल, रोग, महामारी, भगदड़, अकाल, आसुरी सृष्टि — इस प्रकार आपत्तियाँ।
english: From the divine: fire, water, disease, pestilence, flight, famine, demonic creation — thus the adversities.
notes: udaka (water) may mean flood. pramāra literally "dying off" (pestilence or epidemic). vidrava = flight, rout or panic; "flight" kept literal. The Sanskrit has no verb after daivāt.

words.gloss: from prostration before deities and brahmins

hindi: उनकी सिद्धि देवताओं और ब्राह्मणों को प्रणाम करने से होती है।
english: Of these, success is from prostration before deities and brahmins.

text_flags.why: likely typo: "rpaṇi-" is meaningless, praṇipāta (prostration) fits the sense and the metre-free prose

notes: tāsām refers to the adversities (āpadaḥ) of unit 82. The printed rpaṇipātataḥ is not a word; praṇipātataḥ is read (see text_flags).

hindi: अतिवृष्टि, अनावृष्टि, या जो आसुरी सृष्टि हो — उसमें आथर्वण कर्म और सिद्धों के आरम्भ सिद्धियाँ हैं।
english: Excessive rain, or drought, or whatever creation may be demonic: in that, Atharvan action and the undertakings of holy men [are] the successes.
notes: The Sanskrit has no verb in the second line; "[are]" is a bare copula. siddhayaḥ is taken as the predicate. siddha-ārambha could also be "undertakings begun by the accomplished" or "undertakings whose success is assured". Atharvan action: action pertaining to Atharvan (the Atharvaveda); nothing more is stated.
